title: Grateful Dead Live at Dean Smith Center - University of North Carolina on 1993-03-24
venue: Dean Smith Center - University of North Carolina
lineage: Tascam DA-30 -[S/PDIF]-> (48k) Diamond xTreme SC > Cool Edit Pro (44.1k) > CDWave > FLAC (L8)

ai_review.summary: Excellent recording of a sweet Chapel Hill show featuring a standout Spanish Jam and an outstanding second set.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, calling it one of the sweetest shows they've ever seen and highlighting an exceptional second set capped by a memorable Spanish Jam. The recording is praised as “nice work,” indicating clear and enjoyable sound quality despite no technical details being provided.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are 5‑star, uniformly enthusiastic about both the show and the recording; this consistency yields a high rating with strong confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers explicitly compliment the recording quality (“Nice work on the recording”), with no complaints about clarity or mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set singled out as exceptional; overall atmosphere described as sweet, energetic, and well‑balanced with a memorable jam segment.
